meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审查你的网站或应用代码，找出设计问题（如字体、颜色、布局），并逐一改进，同时保持原有功能。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 升级现有网站或应用的设计质量时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个网页的设计，找出需要改进的地方。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并列出设计问题。

say.text: 把这个页面的字体换成更有特色的字体。
say.note: Claude 会替换字体并调整排版。

say.text: 给这个按钮添加悬停和点击动画。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude audits your website or app code, identifies design issues (typography, colors, layout, etc.), and applies targeted upgrades without breaking existing functionality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to upgrade the design quality of an existing website or app.

say_en.text: Audit this webpage design and list improvements.
say_en.note: Claude scans code and lists issues.

say_en.text: Replace the font with a more distinctive one.
say_en.note: Claude swaps fonts and adjusts typography.

say_en.text: Add hover and click animations to this button.
